points.K1: 每年都要学，学完要讨论
points.K6: 射线装置怎样产生X射线
points.K9: 被照过的东西一般不带放射性
points.K19: 准直器、屏蔽设施与铅围裙
points.K20: 疑似破损的源：隔离、报告
points.K31: 领部、中子和指环剂量计
points.K34: 本单位辐射安全操作规程
points.K39: 超量照射靠报告和调查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼走廊，身旁门上有电离辐射警告标志，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a university lab building corridor beside a door with an ionizing radiation warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电离辐射安全。
overlay: 电离辐射安全：从原理到日常防护

shots.scene: 四个图标：原子、时钟、盾牌、剂量计
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an atom, a clock, a shield and a small clip-on dosimeter badge. No people.
shots.narration: 从原理讲到防护，再讲到日常管理。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天到射线装置实验室，小研递给他一个剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives at an X-ray equipment lab on his first day; the female graduate student hands him a small blank dosimeter badge.
shots.narration: 阿杰今天第一次进射线装置实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰把剂量计随手放在洒满阳光的窗台上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student casually puts the dosimeter badge on a sunny windowsill.
shots.narration: 他把剂量计随手放在了窗台上。

shots.scene: 阿杰笑着对小研说话，指着剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The young male student smiles and points at the badge while talking to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 反正有它护着我，戴不戴都一样吧？

shots.scene: 小研摇头，欣欣从旁边探出头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head while the panda mascot leans in from the side.
shots.narration: 这句话错了两处，我们从头说起。

shots.section_title: 每年都要学，学完要讨论
shots.scene: 王老师在会议室给大家上辐射安全课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives a radiation safety class to a small group of students in a meeting room.
shots.narration: 这门课帮工作人员和主管落实辐射安全。
overlay: 每年都要学，学完要讨论

shots.section_title: 每年都要学，学完要讨论
shots.scene: 日历上每年同一格亮起
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with the same slot highlighted on every year page. No people.
shots.narration: 每年看一次，满足初训和复训要求。

shots.section_title: 每年都要学，学完要讨论
shots.scene: 老周带着阿杰、小研围桌讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man leads a discussion with the young male student and the female graduate student around a table.
shots.narration: 看完由主管带着，讨论本岗位的规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着画有向下箭头的空白牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign with a large downward arrow.
shots.narration: 目标只有一个：合理可行，尽量低。

shots.scene: 三个图标：人、负责人、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a worker, a supervisor with a clipboard, and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 靠知情的人员、负责的主管和安全计划。

shots.scene: 空白的胸部透视片和零件透视图
shots.prompt_en: A blank chest X-ray film and an X-ray image of a mechanical part on a light box. No people.
shots.narration: 电离辐射能看透人体，也能检查零件。

shots.scene: 射线装置门口的红色工作指示灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: A red warning light glows above the door of an X-ray equipment room. No people.
shots.narration: 它能量很高，必须严格控制。

shots.scene: 示意图：X射线和γ射线画成波浪光束
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: two wavy beams of high-energy photons. No people.
shots.narration: 一类是高能光子：X射线和γ射线。

shots.scene: 示意图：α、β、中子三种小球
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: three kinds of small particles, a large one, a tiny one and a neutral one. No people.
shots.narration: 一类是粒子：α、β和中子。

shots.scene: 太阳、星空、岩石图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the sun, a starry sky and rocks in the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 太阳、宇宙、地下的岩石都有辐射。

shots.scene: 普通人图标周围有淡淡的光点
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary person icon surrounded by faint glowing dots. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 这叫天然本底，人人一生都在受照。

shots.scene: 小研在射线装置旁，身边一个调节旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside X-ray equipment with a large control knob icon beside her.
shots.narration: 本底管不了，工作中的照射能控制。

shots.section_title: 射线装置怎样产生X射线
shots.scene: 示意图：X射线管里电子撞向靶
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of an X-ray tube: electrons flying from one end and striking a target. No people.
shots.narration: 射线装置用高电压让电子打靶，
overlay: 射线装置怎样产生X射线

shots.section_title: 射线装置怎样产生X射线
shots.scene: 示意图：射线经过滤片和准直器变成窄束
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: rays pass through a filter plate and a collimator and come out as a narrow beam. No people.
shots.narration: 再经过滤和准直，得到需要的射线。

shots.section_title: 射线装置怎样产生X射线
shots.scene: 控制台上的电源钥匙被拔下
shots.prompt_en: A key being removed from a blank control console; a green power-off indicator. No people.
shots.narration: 关掉电源，就不再产生射线。

shots.scene: 示意图：一个原子核放出光和小球
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: an atomic nucleus emitting rays and small particles as it becomes stable. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质衰变，会变得更稳定，

shots.scene: 六个图标：γ、α、β、中子、光、热
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a row: a wave, a big particle, a small particle, a neutral particle, a light bulb and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 同时放出射线、粒子，还有光和热。

shots.scene: 几个不同颜色的原子核图标，各有不同的光
shots.prompt_en: Several atom icons of different colors, each emitting a different pattern of rays. No people.
shots.narration: 不同核素，放出的能量各不相同。

shots.scene: 天花板上的烟雾探测器
shots.prompt_en: A smoke detector on a ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 按用途选核素，比如烟雾探测器里，

shots.scene: 示意图：小源放出α和少量γ
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a tiny sealed source emitting alpha particles and a few gamma rays. No people.
shots.narration: 用的镅源放出α和γ，正好合用。

shots.section_title: 被照过的东西一般不带放射性
shots.scene: 一个零件刚被X射线照过，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A metal part just scanned by X-rays, with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 被X射线照过的东西，一般不会带放射性。
overlay: 被照过的东西一般不带放射性

shots.section_title: 被照过的东西一般不带放射性
shots.scene: 示意图：中子打进物质，物质发光
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: neutrons hitting a block of material which then glows faintly. No people.
shots.narration: 除非受到核反应级别的极强辐射。

shots.scene: 桌子图标打勾，人体轮廓上有闪点
shots.prompt_en: A desk icon with a green check, and a human body outline with small sparks on it. No people.
shots.narration: 大多数物体受照没事，细胞却会受损。

shots.scene: 四个图标：大剂量、反复、全身、敏感器官
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a large dose bar, repeating arrows, a whole body outline and a highlighted organ. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量大、反复受照、大面积、敏感组织，

shots.scene: 欣欣点头竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这时急性损伤才可能明显。

shots.scene: DNA双螺旋被射线击断一处
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix hit by a ray and broken at one point. No people.
shots.narration: 射线能打断DNA，引起突变。

shots.scene: 细胞图标：多数变灰，一个存活变红
shots.prompt_en: A group of cell icons: most turn grey, one damaged cell survives and turns red. No people.
shots.narration: 多数突变细胞会死，修不好的可能癌变。

shots.scene: 一根风险条随受照次数加长
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk bar growing longer with each added exposure mark. No people.
shots.narration: 照得越多，风险越大，能少则少。

shots.scene: 四个图标：时钟、箭头、盾牌、手套
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a clock, a long arrow, a shield and a glove. No people.
shots.narration: 控制照射，靠四招：

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出四个手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up four fingers.
shots.narration: 时间、距离、屏蔽，还有污染控制。

shots.scene: 人站在源旁，时钟指针转动，刻度条变长
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a person icon near a glowing source; a clock turns and a dose bar grows. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 在源旁待得越久，受照越多。

shots.scene: 日历上的小格子一点点累加成一根长条
shots.prompt_en: Small blocks from a calendar stacking up into one tall bar. No people.
shots.narration: 单次察觉不到，但剂量会累加。

shots.scene: 小研在没开机的设备前演练动作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rehearses her moves in front of switched-off X-ray equipment.
shots.narration: 先在不出束时演练一遍，

shots.scene: 控制台上的旋钮调到中间
shots.prompt_en: A control knob on a blank console turned to a middle setting. No people.
shots.narration: 功率调到够用就行，

shots.scene: 计时器图标和一个打叉的重拍图标
shots.prompt_en: A timer icon beside a crossed-out icon of a repeated exposure. No people.
shots.narration: 管好出束时间，避免重拍。

shots.scene: 阿杰从源旁往后退，箭头拉长
shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps back away from a glowing source, with a long arrow on the floor.
shots.narration: 距离是最有效的方法。

shots.scene: 示意图：距离加倍，光斑面积变四倍，强度变暗
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: rays from a point spreading out; at double the distance the same rays cover four times the area and look dimmer. No people.
shots.narration: 距离加一倍，强度降到四分之一。

shots.scene: 欣欣往后退了两步
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot takes two steps back and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 多退几步，差别就很明显。

shots.scene: 人员站在远处的控制台后
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student operates from a control console far away from the X-ray equipment.
shots.narration: 人员尽量远离源，

shots.scene: 地面上画出警戒线围住设备区
shots.prompt_en: A floor area around X-ray equipment marked off with barrier tape and a radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 划定并守住控制区，

shots.scene: 示意图：射束指向墙角空处，有人的门口打叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a beam pointed toward an empty wall, while a beam pointed at a doorway with a person icon is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 射束别朝着可能有人的方向。

shots.scene: 示意图：射线穿过木板、被铅板挡住
shots.prompt_en: A diagram split in two: rays pass mostly through a wooden board on the left, but are mostly stopped by a lead plate on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 挡在中间的材料，都会吸收射线。

shots.scene: 厚墙和薄墙对比
shots.prompt_en: A diagram comparing a thin wall and a thick wall, with fewer rays getting through the thick one. No people.
shots.narration: 越厚、越致密，挡得越多。

shots.scene: 射线机房隔壁是办公室
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan showing an X-ray room next to an occupied office. No people.
shots.narration: 隔壁可能有人，就需要屏蔽。

shots.scene: 老李和王老师审阅空白图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the safety administrator review blank floor plans on a desk.
shots.narration: 屏蔽要先设计好，再按要求施工。

shots.scene: 工人要在机房墙上打孔，图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A drill aimed at a shielded wall of an X-ray room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装修改造，不能随便破坏屏蔽墙。

shots.section_title: 准直器、屏蔽设施与铅围裙
shots.scene: 准直器投下一个小方形光野
shots.prompt_en: An X-ray collimator projecting a small square light field onto a table. No people.
shots.narration: 用准直器，把射束限在需要的地方。
overlay: 准直器、屏蔽设施与铅围裙

shots.section_title: 准直器、屏蔽设施与铅围裙
shots.scene: 带屏蔽门的机房
shots.prompt_en: An X-ray room with a heavy shielded door and a radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 有屏蔽机房就用，没有就严格管控。

shots.section_title: 准直器、屏蔽设施与铅围裙
shots.scene: 小研穿上铅围裙
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lead apron.
shots.narration: 需要时，穿上铅围裙。

shots.section_title: 疑似破损的源：隔离、报告
shots.scene: 一个放射源小罐边有裂缝图标，周围拉起隔离带
shots.prompt_en: A small sealed source container with a crack icon, surrounded by barrier tape. No people.
shots.narration: 怀疑放射源破损泄漏，先隔离，
overlay: 疑似破损的源：隔离、报告

shots.section_title: 疑似破损的源：隔离、报告
shots.scene: 小研打电话给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the safety administrator on the phone.
shots.narration: 并立即联系辐射安全负责人。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套操作，摘手套后洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes off her gloves and washes her hands at a sink.
shots.narration: 勤洗手，是防污染最简单的办法。

shots.scene: 食物、水杯、化妆品图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of food, a cup and cosmetics, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 工作区不吃喝，防止误食和沾染。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表站在机房门口
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank assessment form at the door of an X-ray room.
shots.narration: 每项作业首次运行时，都要评估照射。

shots.scene: 日历上每年一格打勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a check mark on one slot each year. No people.
shots.narration: 每年复核，由辐射安全负责人详细审查。

shots.scene: 示意图：电离室里离子被电极收集
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an ionization chamber: a gas-filled box where ions drift to two electrodes. No people.
shots.narration: 电离室收集射线产生的离子，

shots.scene: 手持巡测仪的空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: A handheld radiation survey meter with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 测电流就知道辐射水平；计数管也能测。

shots.scene: 巡测仪屏幕上只有一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A survey meter display showing only a small clock icon and a bar. No people.
shots.narration: 读数是剂量率，如微伦琴每小时。

shots.scene: 王老师拿巡测仪沿门缝、窗边测量
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks along a door gap and a window with a handheld survey meter.
shots.narration: 凡是可能受照的地方都要测，

shots.scene: 走廊里有路人图标
shots.prompt_en: A corridor outside the lab with passer-by icons. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 包括走廊这样的公众区域。

shots.scene: 计算器和空白表格
shots.prompt_en: A calculator and a blank worksheet on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 再结合使用频率，估算最大可能受照。

shots.scene: 三根刻度尺，各有一条红线
shots.prompt_en: Three blank gauges side by side, each with its own red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 联邦法规给三类人员分别定了限值。

shots.scene: 三根刻度尺上的红线标出数值
shots.prompt_en: Three blank gauges with red limit lines at different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 工作人员每年5雷姆，即50毫希沃特。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着最低的那条红线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the lowest of the three red lines.
shots.narration: 孕期0.5雷姆，公众0.1雷姆，公众最严。

shots.scene: 三个图标：屏蔽墙、防护服、规章本
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a shielding wall, protective gear, and a blank rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 照射偏高，就从三方面改：

shots.scene: 老李在机房加装屏蔽板，王老师旁边记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a shielding panel while the safety administrator takes notes.
shots.narration: 改设备、加防护、调整管理和排班。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研和阿杰发剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands dosimeter badges to the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 根据评估，相关人员要做剂量监测，

shots.scene: 日历分成按月和按季两种
shots.prompt_en: A calendar split into monthly and quarterly sections. No people.
shots.narration: 按月或按季度监测，有些岗位自动纳入。

shots.scene: 孕妇图标旁的日历格子更密
shots.prompt_en: A pregnant woman icon beside a calendar with more frequent check marks. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 怀孕的辐射工作人员，必须按月监测。

shots.scene: 剂量计被射线照射，内部晶片微微发光
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter badge being hit by rays, with the small crystal inside glowing faintly. No people.
shots.narration: 热释光剂量计先把射线能量存起来，

shots.scene: 示意图：晶片被加热后发光
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a small crystal on a heater releasing light. No people.
shots.narration: 加热后以光的形式放出来。

shots.scene: 两个剂量计对比，旁边电脑空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: Two badges compared side by side next to a computer with a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 和对照剂量计比较，算出个人剂量。

shots.scene: 空白剂量报告单
shots.prompt_en: A blank dose report sheet with empty table rows. No people.
shots.narration: 报告列出本期和全年累计，

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上手和眼睛被标出
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with the hands and eyes highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 手、眼等部位也会单独列出。

shots.scene: 小研在空白档案表上签字确认
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank record form at a desk.
shots.narration: 年度记录经辐射安全负责人签字，本人核对。

shots.scene: 四种剂量计图标
shots.prompt_en: Four kinds of dosimeter icons: a badge, a collar badge, a belt badge and a ring. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量计有好几种，

shots.scene: 阿杰把剂量计夹在胸前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clips a dosimeter badge on the front of his chest.
shots.narration: 全身剂量计必戴，夹在胸前躯干上。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿上铅围裙，剂量计在围裙里面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a lead apron, with the dosimeter badge clipped underneath the apron.
shots.narration: 穿铅围裙时，戴在围裙里面。

shots.section_title: 领部、中子和指环剂量计
shots.scene: 小研衣领上夹着第二个剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a second dosimeter badge on her collar above the lead apron.
shots.narration: 围裙挡住胸前时，领口再戴一个。
overlay: 领部、中子和指环剂量计

shots.section_title: 领部、中子和指环剂量计
shots.scene: 剂量计用腰带平贴在腹部
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter badge worn flat against the waist on a belt. No people.
shots.narration: 中子剂量计，平贴在腰腹部。

shots.section_title: 领部、中子和指环剂量计
shots.scene: 手指戴着指环剂量计
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand wearing a ring dosimeter on one finger. No people.
shots.narration: 常手持放射源的人，戴指环剂量计。

shots.scene: 剂量计挂在工作区的专用架上，旁边对照剂量计
shots.prompt_en: Dosimeter badges hanging on a dedicated rack in the lab next to a control badge. No people.
shots.narration: 下班不带走，放回专用位置，

shots.scene: 窗台阳光、暖气片图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sunny windowsill and a radiator, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 别晒太阳、别靠热源，会影响读数。

shots.scene: 阿杰把窗台上的剂量计取回
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks the dosimeter badge back up from the windowsill, looking embarrassed.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶紧把剂量计取了回来。

shots.scene: 腰间同时戴着剂量计和电子报警剂量计
shots.prompt_en: A belt with both a passive dosimeter badge and a small electronic alarm dosimeter. No people.
shots.narration: 高辐射区附近，再加戴报警剂量计。

shots.scene: 报警剂量计和剂量计并列，报警计不能替代，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An electronic alarm dosimeter placed on top of a crossed-out badge outline, showing it cannot replace it. No people.
shots.narration: 它只能配合使用，不能代替剂量计。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，身前一个剂量计和一个没有盾牌的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head beside a dosimeter badge icon and a crossed-out shield icon.
shots.narration: 剂量计只记录，不能挡住射线。

shots.section_title: 本单位辐射安全操作规程
shots.scene: 实验室门边挂着空白的操作规程夹
shots.prompt_en: A blank operating procedure folder hanging beside the lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 这些做法，要写进本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本单位辐射安全操作规程

shots.section_title: 本单位辐射安全操作规程
shots.scene: 规程夹打开，五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The folder opens to show five icons: a machine, a graduation cap, gloves, a shield wall and an alarm bell. No people.
shots.narration: 操作步骤、培训、防护、工程控制，

shots.section_title: 本单位辐射安全操作规程
shots.scene: 老周和阿杰一起看规程
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student read the procedure folder together.
shots.narration: 还有怀疑超量时怎么办，都要写清。

shots.scene: 小研按下急停按钮，关上机房门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses an emergency stop button and closes the X-ray room door.
shots.narration: 发现问题，立即停止操作，保护现场。

shots.scene: 急救十字图标和电话
shots.prompt_en: A first aid cross icon and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时就医。

shots.scene: 小研给老周打电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the older man on her phone.
shots.narration: 联系你的主管，

shots.scene: 王老师接电话，墙上挂着值班表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator answers the phone in an office with a blank duty roster on the wall.
shots.narration: 再联系辐射安全负责人。

shots.scene: 夜间，保卫处值班员接电话
shots.prompt_en: At night, the security officer answers a phone at the campus security duty desk.
shots.narration: 下班时间，通过值班或急诊电话找人。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰各自在空白表上写记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student each write on blank forms at separate desks.
shots.narration: 在场的每个人，都要写下经过：

shots.scene: 四个图标：设备参数、距离、时钟、眼睛
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a control knob, a measuring tape, a clock and an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 设备参数、距离、时间和看到的情况。

shots.scene: 小研举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand to ask the panda mascot a question.
shots.narration: 小研问：辐射会影响以后生孩子吗？

shots.scene: 染色体图标，一对中只有一条有小标记
shots.prompt_en: A chromosome pair icon with a small mark on only one of the two. No people.
shots.narration: 可能影响DNA，但遗传影响机会很小。

shots.scene: 卵细胞图标旁的刻度条慢慢累加
shots.prompt_en: An egg cell icon beside a slowly growing bar. No people.
shots.narration: 卵细胞不会更新，影响会累积。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着向下箭头的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the sign with the downward arrow again.
shots.narration: 所以，照射还是要尽量低。

shots.scene: 孕妇图标旁的胎儿图标被保护罩包住
shots.prompt_en: A pregnant woman icon with a protective bubble around the baby. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 胎儿对辐射特别敏感，孕早期尤甚。

shots.scene: 女性图标走向负责人，旁边医院十字
shots.prompt_en: A woman icon walking toward a supervisor icon, with a hospital cross nearby. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 怀疑怀孕，尽快检查，进入胎儿保护程序。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周一起看空白的岗位安排表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man review a blank work assignment chart together.
shots.narration: 评估工作场所，必要时限制或调整工作。

shots.scene: 检查室里护士图标询问女性图标
shots.prompt_en: A medical staff icon asking a woman icon a question in an X-ray exam room. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 做X射线检查前，也会先问是否怀孕。

shots.section_title: 超量照射靠报告和调查
shots.scene: 仪器上的读数跳高，人却毫无感觉
shots.prompt_en: A person icon standing calmly while a survey meter bar beside them jumps high. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 超量照射，人往往没有感觉。
overlay: 超量照射靠报告和调查

shots.section_title: 超量照射靠报告和调查
shots.scene: 三个图标：门没关、联锁被短接、警示牌缺失
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an open equipment door, a bypassed interlock switch, and a missing warning sign outline. No people.
shots.narration: 常因设备没关、联锁失效、标志不全。

shots.section_title: 超量照射靠报告和调查
shots.scene: 空白报告表和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A blank report form and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 怀疑超量，一律报告，再查原因。

shots.scene: 阿杰去王老师办公室请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student visits the safety administrator's office to ask a question.
shots.narration: 问主管、辐射安全负责人或环境卫生部门。

shots.scene: 书架上的空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of blank binders in an office. No people.
shots.narration: 他们有场所资料和照射评估文件。

shots.scene: 一叠空白法规文本和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank regulation booklets with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质有专门规章和技术规程，

shots.scene: 空白许可证和公章图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank license certificate with a round seal icon. No people.
shots.narration: 受限的放射性材料，要持许可证。

shots.scene: 空白标准文本封面
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard booklet with a radiation trefoil icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 一切照射，以国家辐射防护法规为总依据。

shots.scene: 欣欣面前是一台射线装置，欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands near X-ray equipment and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 电离辐射是好工具，也有潜在危害。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起向下箭头的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the sign with the downward arrow.
shots.narration: 不必害怕，但要尊重，照射尽量低。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，四个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard as four icons light up one by one.
shots.narration: 记住四招：时间、距离、屏蔽、防污染。

shots.scene: 剂量计戴在胸前、领口和手指
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with dosimeter badges on the chest, collar and finger. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量计正确佩戴、妥善保管。

shots.scene: 三根刻度尺和红线
shots.prompt_en: Three blank gauges with red limit lines. No people.
shots.narration: 工作人员、孕期、公众，各有限值。

shots.scene: 电话图标连着负责人和学校
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon linked to a supervisor icon and a university office icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有异常，停下来，马上报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰胸前戴好剂量计，向小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, with his dosimeter badge properly clipped on his chest, nods to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 阿杰把剂量计戴好了，也记住了。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老周、王老师在实验楼门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the female graduate student, the young male student, the older man and the safety administrator in front of the lab building.
shots.narration: 安全用好射线，我们下次见！
